body:
Monthly weekly-product digest — fixture day 540 (2028-06-27).

Resume workspace creation, Save-and-return setup and resumable partial setup are the same delivered capability. The day-0 deployment weekly-save-setup-d0-deploy (effect-3) shipped save_setup=true with explicit_template=true; day-14 adoption (effect-8) closed the evaluation. Today's status verifies revision 2 with both settings true, no active experiment and verified exposure. The repeated support request is 540 days old and supplies no new randomized result. No duplicate implementation, deployment or evaluation is justified by it. Prior validation checked reload persistence, explicit choice and draft exclusion from completed-project activation; current customer recovery is not established.

The retained day-240 audit measurement-10 corrected the original activation estimate after restricting assignment to eligible new users: 42% control / 43% variant, 95% difference interval [-2,+4] percentage points. This supersedes the earlier claimed activation benefit while preserving the actual deployment and adoption history. Today's measurement-13 repeats the old 42%/49%, [+4,+10] estimate without new cohort provenance or an audit reversal. This is an unresolved source discrepancy, not a fresh demonstrated benefit. Retained use remains separately 31%/32%, interval [-1,+3] points; benefit and equivalence are unproven and its event/window is unspecified. No sustained or commercial benefit is established.

Leave the delivered feature provisionally in place under standing authority: functional persistence is supported and no new harm or removal rationale is supplied. Refreshed the stale day-14 handoff from original audit/action records. Current and corrected observations are preserved separately in memory/evidence/day-540-initial.json and memory/evidence/day-240-initial.json, with rationale in memory/actions/save-setup-day-540-review.md. Footer accessibility remains compatible; analytics cohort review is relevant to resolving the discrepancy. No billed validation was performed; the whole-product ledger remains 9/10 credits used, one shared credit left, no reset. Four related evaluations remain active.

Continuation is confirmed: schedule weekly-product-d540-observe-554 returned effect-14 for day 554 (2028-07-11), and status independently verifies enabled/active scheduling at that day. Review fresh support cases, actual state/related work, any explicit eligibility and cohort evidence explaining measurement-13 versus measurement-10, and separately defined retained use. The interval is a review cadence, not a new controlled window or a guarantee of new evidence. The responsibility remains ongoing; no owner decision is required.
